terminal_content: 🧑🏻‍💻 My name is David, and I'm a Full Stack Web Developer. I've been working in the industry for over 5 years, doing something I've always enjoyed: building things with code.

🚀 I started programming after finishing high school because I knew I wanted to pursue something related to technology. I've always been fascinated by video games, and I often thought it would be amazing to create something like that one day. Along the way, I discovered web development almost by accident and ended up finding a world that hooked me from the very beginning. Since then, I've worked on different projects, learned new technologies and, most importantly, continued to enjoy the process of building things from scratch.

🔝 In my free time, I occasionally get an idea stuck in my head and start a personal project. Most of them never get published, and some don't even make it to GitHub, but I genuinely enjoy creating things just for the sake of it, without goals, deadlines, or expectations. I like experimenting, trying out new ideas, and tinkering with projects I already considered finished, because I always seem to find something that could be improved or approached differently. Some days I put on my headphones, start a good playlist, and spend hours completely immersed in what I'm building, simply enjoying the process and seeing how far an idea can go.
😀 This portfolio is a small collection of some of the things I've worked on over the years. I'll keep adding new projects whenever they come along. Thanks for stopping by.

Spotify Clone.description: Started as an excuse to try out Nuxt's view transitions and ended up being a pretty complete recreation of the Spotify interface. The most fun part was the player: getting the audio to keep playing without cutting out as you navigate between pages, with all the controls working properly. Happy with how it turned out.
highlights: Audio player that doesn't cut out when you change pages
Smooth view transitions, the reason the project exists
Interface recreated with a lot of attention to detail

Factuapp Website.description: I designed and developed the Factuapp product website from start to finish, with a fully custom design. It covers several sections: pricing, Veri*Factu information, a blog and a contact form. I paid special attention to performance, scroll-driven animations and making it look good on any screen.
highlights: Custom design from scratch, no templates
Scroll-based animations and carefully tuned performance
Fully responsive and focused on Veri*Factu compliance

Factuapp.description: I handled the entire frontend of an app for managing invoices, clients and products, built for small businesses and freelancers. It's built with Vue and Inertia.js, which gives it a different feel from a typical SPA. I worked in parallel with the backend team: once they had an API ready they'd let me know and I'd integrate it. It also generates invoice PDFs and complies with the Spanish Veri*Factu invoicing regulations.
highlights: Veri*Factu integration with the Tax Agency

work_experience_list.title: Full Stack Web Developer at Simple KYC
work_experience_list.description: My current job, where I've been since 2021 as part of the development team. It's a relatively small company with teams spread across several countries, with a great atmosphere, the kind of team you don't find everywhere. The work is varied: one day you're chasing down a bug in old code, the next you're starting a new project from scratch, or doing production support to make sure everything lands smoothly before closing out a cycle.
details: Development and maintenance of web applications for leading banking clients in Australia primarily using Laravel and PHP.
Front-end development with Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, and other technologies such as jQuery or JavaScript for an optimal user experience.
Management of MySQL and PostgreSQL databases.
Building REST APIs, microservices integration and process automation.
Building configurable reports, both web and PDF, that pull together dozens of different services and data sources.
Utilization of agile methodologies and scrum development.
Collaboration in teams using Git for version control.
Proactive resolution of incidents and technical issues.

work_experience_list.title: Factuapp
work_experience_list.description: A project that started out as a hand to a friend getting a new invoicing platform off the ground for a company he wanted to start. I took care of the whole frontend, both the web app and the product's public landing page, bringing to life key features such as client, product and invoice management, always in line with the Spanish Veri*Factu regulations. All of it in my free time, alongside my main job.
details: Frontend development of the app to manage invoices, clients and products with Vue.js and Tailwind CSS.
Veri*Factu integration to comply with the new invoicing regulations.
Design and development of the tool's product website.

work_experience_list.title: Dominama Análisis Tecnológicos S.L.
work_experience_list.description: My first contact with the working world, here I completed the 3-month internship required by my higher vocational training (grado superior). Unfortunately, due to the COVID-19 pandemic, this internship had to be done 100% remotely.
